description: This Java source file defines utility methods for managing and rendering a tree table displaying VM trace statistics, including adjusting column widths, setting cell renderers, enabling search and sorting, and custom renderers for specific data types.

classes.name: VmStatsTreeUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for configuring and rendering VM statistics tree tables.

classes.name: ProfileTimeRenderer
classes.description: Custom cell renderer for displaying profile time data with formatted numbers and percentages.

classes.name: TableHeaderCellRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for centering table header titles.

methods.name: adjustTableColumnWidths
methods.description: Adjusts the preferred width of each column in a TreeTable based on sample text width.

methods.name: getSampleTextForColumn
methods.description: Retrieves sample text for a specific column index from StatsTableColumn enumeration.

methods.name: setCellRenderers
methods.description: Sets header and cell renderers for specific columns in the TreeTable.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a specific TableColumn from a TreeTable based on StatsTableColumn.

methods.name: setSpeedSearch
methods.description: Enables search functionality on the TreeTable with pattern matching.

methods.name: enableSorting
methods.description: Adds mouse listener to TreeTable header to enable sorting by column when clicked.

methods.name: customizeCellRenderer
methods.description: Formats cell content based on data type, including numbers and pairs of values.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Formats a Double as a percentage string with fixed length.

methods.name: prefixWithSpaces
methods.description: Prefixes a string with spaces or figure spaces to align text properly.

methods.name: getTableCellRendererComponent
methods.description: Returns a component for rendering table header cells with centered text.
